card_text: Color and perms planned from Roswell: the longest bookings on my menu, and how to build the day around 285.

seo.title: Hair Color & Perm for Roswell, NM | Divinely Faded
seo.description: Men's hair color and perms for anyone driving from Roswell, done in Carlsbad about 92 minutes on US 285. A full day for color, a half day for a perm.

paragraphs: Color and perms are the two longest things I do, and I do them in Carlsbad, {{city:roswell.drive_mi}} miles south of Roswell on {{city:roswell.route}}. The drive runs about {{city:roswell.drive_min}} minutes (OpenStreetMap routing), and a Color Transformation holds {{minutes:color-transformation}} on Booksy, so this is the appointment you build a whole day around.
A Perm is shorter, at {{minutes:perm}}, and fits the same trip with room to spare.

blocks.heading: Shade or shape.
blocks.lead: Two bookings, two very different lengths.

items.title: Color Transformation
items.body: Bleaching and toning to land on the shade you're after. The longest slot on my menu; keep the rest of the day open.

items.title: Perm
items.body: A customized perm for volume, texture and movement. Long enough to justify the trip, short enough to leave the afternoon.

blocks.heading: Build it around the chair.
paragraphs: Say you book color for the morning. You leave Roswell early, pass Artesia at the halfway mark, sit for {{minutes:color-transformation}}, and roll back onto 285 in the afternoon. There's no version of this that fits between other errands, so don't try. Bring a photo of the shade, eat before you come, and keep your phone charged for the sit.
A perm flips that: {{minutes:perm}} in the chair leaves time to do something else in Carlsbad before the drive home, or to head straight back and still beat the evening.

blocks.heading: Text the picture.
paragraphs: The longest bookings are the ones I least want to guess on. Text a photo of the color or the curl you're aiming for to {{phone}} before you book, and I'll tell you which service gets you there. Payment is after the service, and because these slots take a big piece of my day, cancel early on Booksy if plans change; a late cancellation or no-show may carry a fee.
Color is for the hair on your head only. I don't dye beards.

items.q: How long is the whole day for a Color Transformation from Roswell?
items.a: About {{city:roswell.drive_min}} minutes each way plus {{minutes:color-transformation}} in the chair. Count on the full day.

items.q: What does a perm cost and how long does it take?
Does the Color Transformation include toning?
items.a: Yes. Bleaching and toning are both part of the {{price:color-transformation}} service.
